raw_segments.text: As they, both of them, desired nothing more than to hear from his own lips the cause of
his suffering, they entreated him to tell it, promising not to do anything for his relief
or comfort that he did not wish.
And thereupon, the unhappy gentleman began his sad story in nearly the same words and
manner in which he had related it to Don Quixote and the goat herd a few days before, when,
through Master Elisabod and Don Quixote's scrupulous observance of what was due to chivalry,
the tale was left unfinished, as this history has already recorded.
But now fortunately the mad fit kept off, allowed him to tell it to the end.
